media.alt: Premium handyman services in Sydney Eastern Suburbs

intro.heading: Real Tradespeople. Real Results.
paragraphs: Lavoretti's has been serving Bondi and the Eastern Suburbs for over a decade. With over 150 five-star Google reviews and hundreds of completed jobs, we are dedicated to delivering outcomes that exceed expectations.

Our approach is built on professional care and zero shortcuts. Whether it's refreshing a single room, mounting a TV, or managing a small-scale renovation, we offer end-to-end solutions that simplify the process and elevate your property.
From minor home improvements to commercial office fitouts, our commitment to quality has made us the partner of choice for homeowners, landlords, and property managers alike throughout Sydney's East.

servicesOverview.title: General Handyman
servicesOverview.description: TV mounting, shelving, flatpack assembly, curtain rails, door hardware — if it needs doing, it gets done right with precision and care.

servicesOverview.title: Professional Painting
servicesOverview.description: Interior & exterior painting, wall & ceiling repaints, trim restoration, patching & plaster repairs, bringing life back to your spaces.

servicesOverview.title: Property Maintenance
servicesOverview.description: Regular upkeep for landlords and property managers. We handle end-of-lease repairs and keep everything in top shape between tenancies.

servicesOverview.title: Small Renovations
servicesOverview.description: Minor home improvements and upgrades — bathrooms, courtyards, kitchens — that completely transform your space with premium finishes.

detailedServicesList.title: General Handyman
detailedServicesList.content: From mounting heavy TVs securely to assembling complex flatpacks, installing custom shelving, and fixing door hardware. We handle the vital details that keep your home or business running smoothly.

detailedServicesList.title: Professional Painting
detailedServicesList.content: Expert interior and exterior painting services. We handle everything from minor touch-ups and plaster patching to full room repaints, ensuring a flawless, premium finish every time.

detailedServicesList.title: Property Maintenance & End of Lease
detailedServicesList.content: Reliable, ongoing maintenance for landlords, property managers, and businesses. We execute comprehensive end-of-lease repairs, touch-ups, and fixes so you get your bond back or have the property ready for the next tenant without stress.

detailedServicesList.title: Small Renovations & Fitouts
detailedServicesList.content: Transforming spaces through minor renovations. Whether it's upgrading a bathroom, completely rebuilding a courtyard with hardwood decking, or executing a commercial office fitout, we deliver real results.

hero.heading: About Lavoretti's
hero.subHeading: A decade of trust in the Eastern Suburbs.

content.heading: Built on Professional Care and Zero Shortcuts
paragraphs: For over a decade, Lavoretti's has been the go-to maintenance and handyman service for Bondi and Sydney's Eastern Suburbs. Our reputation is built on a simple premise: real tradespeople delivering real results.

We understand that whether you are a homeowner needing a quick repair, a property manager requiring reliable maintenance, or a business executing a full commercial fitout, you need a team that respects your time and property. With over 150 five-star reviews, our track record speaks for itself.
We do not believe in shortcuts. Every project, no matter how small, is approached with the same dedication to quality, clear communication, and premium finishing.

info.responsePromise: Most jobs responded to within 24 hours.
